source.article_title: Orange photons (623 nm) resulted in similar or greater lettuce growth than red photons (660 nm): comparative effects on morphology, photon capture, and photosynthesis
source.source_figure: Figure 7: Rex leaf absorptance, transmittance, and reflectance curves by treatment

model_grid.basis: common integer grid where every treatment has reflectance and transmittance; intentionally not clipped to direct absorptance coverage

treatments.treatment_label: Mean of Orange, Red, O+FR, R+FR

columns.absorptance_fraction_raw_digitized: Direct absorptance digitization where available; blank outside direct absorptance range.
columns.transmittance_fraction_raw_digitized: Direct transmittance digitization interpolated to model grid.
columns.reflectance_fraction_raw_digitized: Direct reflectance digitization interpolated to model grid.
columns.absorptance_fraction_implied_from_rt_raw: Unclamped 1 - raw reflectance - raw transmittance. May be negative where digitized R+T exceeds 1.
columns.absorptance_fraction_implied_from_rt: Clamped implied absorptance in [0,1] used only where raw absorptance is missing.
columns.absorptance_fraction_model: Preferred absorption model: direct raw absorptance where available, otherwise clamped implied A from R/T.
columns.transmittance_fraction_model: Budget-constrained model transmittance preserving raw T:R ratio after absorptance is set.
columns.reflectance_fraction_model: Budget-constrained model reflectance preserving raw R:T ratio after absorptance is set.
columns.rt_model_adjustment: How raw R/T were scaled to preserve the chosen absorptance and keep model A+T+R=1.

important_notes: No peak normalization was applied; percent values were converted to fractions only.
Reflectance/transmittance were preserved to the 404-797 nm model grid and were not clipped to the direct absorptance range.
Missing direct absorptance is not treated as zero absorption.
Where raw absorptance is missing, A is inferred from R/T; if digitized R+T exceeds 1, implied A is clamped to 0 and R/T are scaled to a unit budget.
Use absorptance_fraction_model for per-wavelength modeled absorbed photon flux.
Raw digitized R/T columns are retained for auditability, but model R/T columns are budget-constrained.
This profile supports modeled leaf optical absorption only; it is not a photosynthesis, biomass, morphology, or yield model.
